title: Denver P NDE 3465
content: The warm and commanding voice of Christ asked me one simple question, 'Denver, are you prepared to leave?' I pleaded with Him to allow me to live because my best friend at the time had refused to come to know Christ as his Savior, and my mother would be destroyed without me. I was semi-conscious at this moment. The room was dark and half lit with all kinds of medical technology breathing for me, monitoring my vital signs, and the kinds of things you would see in an ICU. Yet, when Christ's voice spoke to me, the whole room seemed to become brighter than normal. I'm not sure if I fell asleep or blacked out after this. I had not slept all night because of the gasping laborious attempts to breathe and get oxygen. I floated and traversed over the greenest prairie of tall grass. I could not believe that my being was floating above the ground. It was more exhilarating than any roller coaster! In the center was a very ancient and Holy tree which I believe was the Tree of Life. Beings of all spectrum of light also floated and traveled about. There was no pain. There was no suffering. I felt a sense of euphoric calm that is very difficult to express in words. Remember now, it was during this time that the doctor had told my mother to prepare of the possibility of losing me. All beings chanted the graces of God and praised him. I feel a leap of excitement every time I relive that moment! I was pulled back down through a dark tunnel back into the ICU, where medical staff were preparing me to leave. They were at this point rushing me to the nearest regional hospital, to see the region's leading expert on pulmonary issues. I was later told that they were going to open up my chest and remove the clot. I remember gasping for air! I was removed from the breathing machine. They had a trachea tube coming out of my throat. They attached a large rubber bulb connected to tank of oxygen, and squeezed it rhythmically to breath for me. When I arrived 45 minutes later at the regional hospital the expert began running X-rays and other tests. Very frustrated, he called the doctor at the hospital I'd just been sent from. He was quoted as saying, 'Doctor, you send me a dying boy needing surgery and I'll be damned if I can find a thing wrong with him!' The doctor was floored! On later follow up visits to see him, after being released from ICU, he kept repeating that he saw no other alternative than to call this a miracle from God!
